title: Singular Equilibrium and Selection of Narratives
abstract: arXiv:2610.11615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent learns from data that many parameters of her model explain equally well. Berk's theorem states that her belief concentrates on the parameters that best fit the data, but does not select between them. We show that, with a continuum of parameters, the posterior concentrates on the best-fitting parameters with the smallest local learning coefficient. We propose a definition of narratives, subsets of the best-fitting parameters on which the learning coefficient is constant. Narratives are characterized by the number of coincidences they require (complexity) and how exactly each must hold (robustness). When the agent's actions affect her data, every long-run action is a singular equilibrium, a best reply to a belief supported on the least complex and most robust narratives. translated_title: 奇异均衡与叙事的选择
translated_abstract: 智能体从数据中得知，其模型中的许多参数都能同样好地解释数据。伯克定理指出，她的信念会集中于最能拟合数据的参数，但不会在这些参数之间做出进一步选择。我们证明，当参数空间为连续统时，后验分布会集中于局部学习系数最小的最优拟合参数。我们提出了“叙事”的定义，即学习系数保持恒定的最优拟合参数的子集。叙事由两个特征刻画：其所需的巧合数量（复杂度），以及每个巧合必须成立的精确程度（稳健性）。当智能体的行为会影响其数据时，每一个长期行为都是一个奇异均衡——即对由最简单且最稳健的叙事所支持的信念的最优反应。奇异均衡通过排除过度复杂或处于刀锋边缘的路径外信念，精炼了伯克-纳什均衡和自确认均衡，其严格一致版本（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“奇异均衡”概念，证明当连续统多个参数同样拟合数据时，后验信念会集中于最简单且最稳健的“叙事”（即局部学习系数最小的参数子集），并以此精炼了伯克-纳什均衡与自确认均衡。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "singular equilibrium," showing that when a continuum of parameters fit the data equally well, the posterior concentrates on the least complex and most robust "narratives" (those with the smallest local learning coefficient), thereby refining Berk-Nash and self-confirming equilibrium.
